title: Descent
description: A pale woman in a silver gown descends a grand spiral staircase inside a decaying theater. Film reels, clapperboards, and broken red seats litter the flooded floor while a beam of light cuts through the dark space from an upper balcony.
prompt: Surreal cinematic scene inside a decaying ornate theater with a flooded floor covered in film reels, clapperboards and broken red velvet seats. A pale woman in a flowing silver gown and white face paint descends a grand spiral staircase. Dramatic beam of light cuts through the darkness from above. Film reels float near the ceiling, movie screen in the background displays the word DESCENT, bats flying, swirling cosmic ceiling mural, moody and atmospheric, detailed digital painting
